narration: Ishaan wedges the torch on top, face up. It points at the ceiling.
caption: इशान टॉर्च को सबसे ऊपर फँसा देता है, मुँह ऊपर। वह छत की तरफ़ देखती है।
image_brief: The torch standing upright and wedged on a stack of four books on the stool, its beam shooting straight up.

narration: The stripe leaves the floor. It lies across the ceiling.
caption: पट्टी फ़र्श छोड़ देती है। वह छत के आर-पार पड़ जाती है।
image_brief: A long bright band of light lying across the bedroom ceiling above the two cots, the rest of the room dark.

narration: A stripe on a ceiling is already crocodile-shaped. Long. Thin.
caption: छत पर पड़ी पट्टी पहले से मगरमच्छ जैसी है। लंबी। पतली।
image_brief: The band of light on the ceiling seen from Ishaan's pillow, its soft edges and the ceiling boards showing inside it.

narration: Now both his hands are free. The books hold the torch.
caption: अब उसके दोनों हाथ ख़ाली हैं। किताबें टॉर्च को थामे हैं।
image_brief: Ishaan's two open empty hands on either side of the book stack, the propped torch glowing upward between them.

narration: Ishaan slides his hands just above the glass. Closer means bigger.
caption: इशान अपने हाथ काँच के थोड़ा ऊपर ले जाता है। पास जाओ तो बड़ा होता है।
image_brief: Ishaan's interlocked jaw-shaped hands held low over the upward-pointing torch, light blazing through the gaps.

narration: Ishaan's jaws unroll from the door to the window.
caption: इशान का जबड़ा दरवाज़े से खिड़की तक फैल जाता है।
image_brief: An enormous crocodile jaw shadow stretching across the whole ceiling from above the door to above the window.

narration: Huge. Longer than both cots together.
caption: बहुत बड़ा। दोनों खाटों से भी लंबा।
image_brief: The ceiling crocodile shadow spanning above both cots, the two children tiny underneath it on their blankets.

narration: But the stripe is narrow. Ishaan's crocodile loses its legs.
caption: पर पट्टी पतली है। इशान के मगरमच्छ के पैर ग़ायब हो जाते हैं।
image_brief: The ceiling crocodile with its body inside the band of light and its leg shapes lost in the dark beside the band.

narration: A crocodile needs feet. Ishaan has no hands left.
caption: मगरमच्छ को पैर चाहिए। इशान के पास और हाथ नहीं हैं।
image_brief: Ishaan's hands fully busy making the jaw above the torch, his elbows locked, nothing else of him free.

narration: So Ishaan asks for her rabbit, not her torch.
caption: तो इशान उससे टॉर्च नहीं, उसका खरगोश माँगता है।
image_brief: Ishaan turning his head toward his sister while his hands stay in the beam, the sister lifting her head off the pillow.

narration: Two ears slide in under Ishaan's jaws. She holds them still.
caption: दो कान इशान के जबड़े के नीचे आ जाते हैं। वह उन्हें स्थिर रखती है।
image_brief: The sister's two-fingered rabbit hand entering the beam just below Ishaan's joined hands, both sets of fingers lit.

narration: Say it with Ishaan, out loud.
caption: इशान के साथ ज़ोर से बोलो।
image_brief: Two children's hands together in one upward beam of light, their mouths open mid-word, the bright ceiling above.

narration: Ishaan says it with her. One snap, two snap, crocodile!
caption: इशान उसके साथ बोलता है। एक चटक, दो चटक, मगरमच्छ!
image_brief: Ishaan and his sister kneeling side by side at the stool, faces lit from below, the ceiling crocodile shut above them.

narration: On the ceiling the ears become two waving feet.
caption: छत पर वे कान दो हिलते हुए पैर बन जाते हैं।
image_brief: The ceiling crocodile with two small waving foot shapes under its long body, everything inside the band of light.

narration: Then she edges her hands nearer. Her rabbit fills Ishaan's ceiling too.
caption: फिर वह अपने हाथ और पास ले जाती है। उसका खरगोश भी इशान की छत भर देता है।
image_brief: A giant rabbit shadow with tall ears filling the ceiling band, the sister's hands close over the torch, Ishaan leaning back.
